dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem a little down. What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Well, that probably has something to do with you... or myself, rather. I was bragging about how I'd have struck it rich the next time we met...

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: But the truth is, wealth has remained as elusive as ever.
